column1: # One row per source file and raw call: PATH<TAB>SYMBOL<TAB>COUNT. COUNT is the
# number of calls the file carries today. The check fails when a file exceeds
# its count, so the raw calls cannot spread. Replace a call with the matching
# internal/rootio primitive, lower the count, and delete the row when the count
# reaches zero. New code states its case at the call site with a
# "// hardened-fs-exempt: <reason>" comment instead of a row here.
# Seeded from origin/main; the rule was never enforced before this file.
